name: Move Google Search Ads 360 Data to Amazon Redshift
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Google Search Ads 360** as the data source.
2.  Select your added **Redshift** data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize your Google Search Ads account to add Credentials.
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/google-search-ads/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
